schedule-view.description: Chronological day-grouped agenda with windowed pagination. The default below 640px.

examples.note: Paginate with the toolbar inside the agenda. Only the visible window renders: switch to the 1000-event dataset and watch the DOM stay bounded.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone schedule view component.

locales.note: Days, times, and helper texts follow the selected locale.

props.note: Pass events (recurrence expands inside the window only, the array is never mutated), tasks, and resolved holidays. Day clicks never move the window anchor; pagination is explicit.

size-density.note: Size drives day badges and item text while density drives day padding.

schedule-view.title: Schedule View
